note: Terms module-04 introduces, and the build that teaches each. Enforced by scripts/lint-glossary.mjs. Keep ASCII-only.

terms.gloss: The governed list of categories a ticket can be, and which symptom means which. Owned by one person so it changes on purpose.
Deciding, fast, what something is, how bad it is and who gets it - before anyone works on it.
Priority levels from the matrix. P1 means many people are affected AND blocked - the only level that pages an engineer.
A grid that turns impact and urgency into a priority, so priority is decided by a rule instead of by how loudly someone asked.
Which queue works which category. Config, owned by the Queue Lead - change the table, not the flow.
The on-call person saying 'I have it'. A page is not handled until it is acknowledged.
A ticket triage sent to one queue that turned out to belong to another. The raw material for improving the taxonomy.
Who is paged next when the first person does not answer, and after how long.
